comparison.objective: Assemble and mesh three gears on assigned shafts, versus set and lock an angular-gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-893 requires shaft insertion and tooth-phase discovery by contact; the candidate requires screw adjustment, jam-nut counterholding, and tool regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: PR-893 requires three seated, meshed, still gears with arms clear; the candidate requires angle accuracy, locking, low drift, and repeated articulated motion.
comparison.reason: Gear phasing and multi-part insertion are meaningfully different from adjustment retention under locknut torque.
